const corresponding = {
  A: "viseme_PP",
  B: "viseme_kk",
  C: "viseme_I",
  D: "viseme_AA",
  E: "viseme_O",
  F: "viseme_U",
  G: "viseme_FF",
  H: "viseme_TH",
  X: "viseme_PP",
};

let setupMode = false;

export function Avatar(props) {
  const { nodes, materials, animations } = useGLTF('/models/boy.glb');

  const { message, onMessagePlayed, chat } = useChat();

  // state + refs
  const [lipsync, setLipsync] = useState(null);
  const audioRef = useRef(null);
  const group = useRef();
  const { actions, mixer } = useAnimations(animations, group);

  const [animation, setAnimation] = useState(
    animations.find((a) => a.name === "Idle") ? "Idle" : (animations[0]?.name ?? "")
  );

  const [blink, setBlink] = useState(false);
  const [winkLeft, setWinkLeft] = useState(false);
  const [winkRight, setWinkRight] = useState(false);
  const [facialExpression, setFacialExpression] = useState("default");

  // Auto-scale & center the model so it's visible (adjust targetHeight if needed)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!group.current) return;

    const handle = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      try {
        // Compute bounding box of the group (which contains the Armature)
        const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(group.current);
        const size = new THREE.Vector3();
        box.getSize(size);
        const maxDim = Math.max(size.x, size.y, size.z);

        // desired model height in scene units (tweak this to taste)
        const targetHeight = 2.0; // try 1.5 - 3.0 depending on desired size

        if (maxDim > 0) {
          const scaleFactor = targetHeight / maxDim;

          // apply uniform scale to the root group
          group.current.scale.setScalar(scaleFactor);

          // re-calc box after scaling so we can align to ground
          const scaledBox = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(group.current);
          const minY = scaledBox.min.y;

          // move model so its lowest point sits at y = 0 (ground)
          group.current.position.y -= minY;

          // Optional: center horizontally on X/Z (uncomment if model offset)
          // const center = new THREE.Vector3();
          // scaledBox.getCenter(center);
          // group.current.position.x -= center.x;
          // group.current.position.z -= center.z;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("auto-scale failed:", e);
      }
    });

    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(handle);
  }, [nodes]);

  // When message changes: set animation, expression, lipsync and play audio (safely)
  useEffect(() => {
    // clear previous audio
    if (audioRef.current) {
      try {
        audioRef.current.pause();
      } catch (e) {}
      try {
        audioRef.current.onended = null;
      } catch (e) {}
      audioRef.current = null;
    }

    if (!message) {
      setAnimation("Idle");
      setFacialExpression("default");
      setLipsync(null);
      return;
    }

    // apply animation + expression + lipsync
    if (message.animation) setAnimation(message.animation);
    if (message.facialExpression) setFacialExpression(message.facialExpression);
    setLipsync(message.lipsync ?? null);

    // play audio if available
    const playAudioSafely = async () => {
      if (message.audio) {
        try {
          const audio = new Audio("data:audio/mp3;base64," + message.audio);
          audioRef.current = audio;
          // onended should remove current message from queue
          audio.onended = () => {
            try {
              onMessagePlayed();
            } catch (e) {}
          };
          // attempt to play; catch and fallback to speechSynthesis
          try {
            await audio.play();
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn("Audio play failed, falling back to SpeechSynthesis:", err);
            audioRef.current = null;
            // try browser TTS fallback
            const text = message.text ?? message.content ?? "";
            if (typeof window !== "undefined" && "speechSynthesis" in window && text) {
              const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
              u.onend = () => {
                try {
                  onMessagePlayed();
                } catch (e) {}
              };
              window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
            } else {
              // If no TTS available, still call onMessagePlayed so queue proceeds
              try {
                onMessagePlayed();
              } catch (e) {}
            }
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn("Failed to create/play audio, using fallback TTS:", err);
          audioRef.current = null;
          const text = message.text ?? message.content ?? "";
          if (typeof window !== "undefined" && "speechSynthesis" in window && text) {
            const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
            u.onend = () => {
              try {
                onMessagePlayed();
              } catch (e) {}
            };
            window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
          } else {
            try {
              onMessagePlayed();
            } catch (e) {}
          }
        }
      } else {
        // no audio in message -> use speech synthesis fallback (if available)
        const text = message.text ?? message.content ?? "";
        if (text && typeof window !== "undefined" && "speechSynthesis" in window) {
          const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
          u.onend = () => {
            try {
              onMessagePlayed();
            } catch (e) {}
          };
          window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
        } else {
          // nothing to play -> immediately advance
          try {
            onMessagePlayed();
          } catch (e) {}
        }
      }
    };

    playAudioSafely();
    // cleanup handled at top of effect
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [message, onMessagePlayed]);

  // Animation play/stop effect (safe checks)
  useEffect(() => {
    // find action safely
    const action = actions?.[animation];
    if (!action) {
      // If action not found, don't crash — keep idle or no-op
      return;
    }
    // determine whether to fade in or not; mixer.stats may be undefined
    const inUse = mixer?.stats?.actions?.inUse ?? 0;
    try {
      action.reset?.();
      action.fadeIn(inUse === 0 ? 0 : 0.5);
      action.play?.();
    } catch (e) {
      // swallow errors from actions so UI doesn't crash
      console.warn("Animation action play failed:", e);
    }
    return () => {
      try {
        action.fadeOut?.(0.5);
      } catch (e) {}
    };
  }, [animation, actions, mixer]);

  // morph target lerp helper (safe)
  const lerpMorphTarget = (target, value, speed = 0.1) => {
    if (!nodes?.EyeLeft) return;
    sceneTraverseAndApplyMorph(target, value, speed);
    if (!setupMode) {
      try {
        set({ [target]: value });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  };

  // extracted traversal to keep code tidy and safe
  const sceneTraverseAndApplyMorph = (target, value, speed) => {
    try {
      // traverse all skinned meshes that have morph targets
      // nodes might be undefined for some models; guard heavily
      Object.values(nodes).forEach((child) => {
        if (!child || !child.isSkinnedMesh) return;
        const dict = child.morphTargetDictionary;
        const influences = child.morphTargetInfluences;
        if (!dict || !influences) return;
        const index = dict[target];
        if (index === undefined || influences[index] === undefined) return;
        influences[index] = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(influences[index], value, speed);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      // don't crash on unexpected node shapes
    }
  };

  // lipsync related state handled in useFrame
  useFrame(() => {
    if (setupMode) return;

    // guard nodes & morphTargetDictionary availability
    if (!nodes?.EyeLeft?.morphTargetDictionary) return;

    const mapping = facialExpressions[facialExpression] ?? {};
    // apply expression mapping for all morph keys (skip blink keys)
    Object.keys(nodes.EyeLeft.morphTargetDictionary).forEach((key) => {
      if (key === "eyeBlinkLeft" || key === "eyeBlinkRight") return;
      const targetValue = mapping[key] ?? 0;
      lerpMorphTarget(key, targetValue, 0.1);
    });

    // blink/winks handled separately
    lerpMorphTarget("eyeBlinkLeft", blink || winkLeft ? 1 : 0, 0.5);
    lerpMorphTarget("eyeBlinkRight", blink || winkRight ? 1 : 0, 0.5);

    // LIPSYNC: only if we have message, lipsync JSON, and audio element
    if (message && lipsync && audioRef.current) {
      const currentAudioTime = audioRef.current.currentTime ?? 0;
      let applied = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < (lipsync.mouthCues?.length ?? 0); i++) {
        const mouthCue = lipsync.mouthCues[i];
        if (!mouthCue) continue;
        if (currentAudioTime >= mouthCue.start && currentAudioTime <= mouthCue.end) {
          const viseme = corresponding[mouthCue.value] ?? null;
          if (viseme) {
            lerpMorphTarget(viseme, 1, 0.2);
            applied = true;
          }
          break;
        }
      }
      // clear other visemes
      Object.values(corresponding).forEach((value) => {
        if (!value) return;
        if (applied && lipsync.mouthCues?.some((c) => corresponding[c.value] === value && audioRef.current.currentTime >= c.start && audioRef.current.currentTime <= c.end)) {
          // keep it
        } else {
          lerpMorphTarget(value, 0, 0.1);
        }
      });
    } else {
      // no lipsync -> ensure all visemes return to 0
      Object.values(corresponding).forEach((value) => {
        if (!value) return;
        lerpMorphTarget(value, 0, 0.1);
      });
    }
  });

  // blink scheduler
  useEffect(() => {
    let blinkTimeout;
    const nextBlink = () => {
      blinkTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        setBlink(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          setBlink(false);
          nextBlink();
        }, 200);
      }, THREE.MathUtils.randInt(1000, 5000));
    };
    nextBlink();
    return () => clearTimeout(blinkTimeout);
  }, []);

  // Leva controls
  useControls("FacialExpressions", {
    chat: button(() => chat && chat("Hello?")),
    winkLeft: button(() => {
      setWinkLeft(true);
      setTimeout(() => setWinkLeft(false), 300);
    }),
    winkRight: button(() => {
      setWinkRight(true);
      setTimeout(() => setWinkRight(false), 300);
    }),
    animation: {
      value: animation,
      options: animations.map((a) => a.name),
      onChange: (value) => setAnimation(value),
    },
    facialExpression: {
      options: Object.keys(facialExpressions),
      onChange: (value) => setFacialExpression(value),
    },
    enableSetupMode: button(() => { setupMode = true; }),
    disableSetupMode: button(() => { setupMode = false; }),
    logMorphTargetValues: button(() => {
      try {
        const emotionValues = {};
        if (!nodes?.EyeLeft) return console.log("{}");
        Object.keys(nodes.EyeLeft.morphTargetDictionary).forEach((key) => {
          if (key === "eyeBlinkLeft" || key === "eyeBlinkRight") return;
          const idx = nodes.EyeLeft.morphTargetDictionary[key];
          const value = nodes.EyeLeft.morphTargetInfluences?.[idx] ?? 0;
          if (value > 0.01) emotionValues[key] = value;
        });
        console.log(JSON.stringify(emotionValues, null, 2));
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("logMorphTargetValues failed:", e);
      }
    }),
  });

  // dynamic morph target controls object (used by leva)
  const [, set] = useControls("MorphTarget", () =>
    Object.assign(
      {},
      ...Object.keys(nodes?.EyeLeft?.morphTargetDictionary ?? {}).map((key) => {
        const minVal = nodes?.EyeLeft?.morphTargetInfluences?.[nodes.EyeLeft.morphTargetDictionary[key]] ?? 0;
        return {
          [key]: {
            label: key,
            value: 0,
            min: minVal,
            max: 1,
            onChange: (val) => {
              if (setupMode) {
                // directly set morph target when in setup mode
                lerpMorphTarget(key, val, 1);
              }
            },
          },
        };
      })
    )
  );

  return (
    <group ref={group} {...props} dispose={null}>
      <group name="Scene">
        <group name="Armature" rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={1}>
          <skinnedMesh
            name="Object_2"
            geometry={nodes.Object_2.geometry}
            material={materials['Material.001']}
            skeleton={nodes.Object_2.skeleton}
          />
          <skinnedMesh
            name="Object_3"
            geometry={nodes.Object_3.geometry}
            material={materials['Material.002']}
            skeleton={nodes.Object_3.skeleton}
          />
          <skinnedMesh
            name="Object_4"
            geometry={nodes.Object_4.geometry}
            material={materials['Material.003']}
            skeleton={nodes.Object_4.skeleton}
          />
          <skinnedMesh
            name="Object_5"
            geometry={nodes.Object_5.geometry}
            material={materials['Material.004']}
            skeleton={nodes.Object_5.skeleton}
          />
          <skinnedMesh
            name="Object_6"
            geometry={nodes.Object_6.geometry}
            material={materials['Material.005']}
            skeleton={nodes.Object_6.skeleton}
          />
          <skinnedMesh
            name="Object_7"
            geometry={nodes.Object_7.geometry}
            material={materials['Material.006']}
            skeleton={nodes.Object_7.skeleton}
          />
          <skinnedMesh
            name="Object_8"
            geometry={nodes.Object_8.geometry}
            material={materials['Material.007']}
            skeleton={nodes.Object_8.skeleton}
          />
          <primitive object={nodes.mixamorigHips} />
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  );
}
